verdicts.explanation: The introduction states that Dai et al. [24] reported AAlCl2.5O0.75 (A = Li+, Na+) with σLi+ ∼ 1.5 mS cm−1, so the value, unit and material (LiAlCl2.5O0.75) match. The citation marks it as literature_cited, and the paper gives no measurement temperature, so the null temperature is correct.

The same introduction sentence gives σNa+ ∼ 1.3 mS cm−1 for the Dai et al. [24] oxyhalide, so the value, unit and material (NaAlCl2.5O0.75) match. It is correctly marked literature_cited, and the temperature is correctly null.
